title: Likelihood of revenue loss in the late-year rebound scenario

claims.text: The late-year rebound variant applies a La Nina rebound climate extension with empirical dependence and is drawn from the sensitivity table; scenario labels are labels, not ratios to fitted central parameters.

The reported value is the probability of any revenue loss in that scenario's conditional distribution, not the probability that the scenario itself occurs; the sensitivity alternatives are not assigned occurrence probabilities and do not define a calibrated credible interval.

limitations: Scenario values are conditional sensitivities, not occurrence likelihoods; alternatives do not bracket a calibrated credible interval.
The probability of loss is reported for the all_modeled aggregate over the joint two-year horizon; country quantiles are never summed.
Values derive from a conditional event study whose historical validation is conditional and does not establish causal identification.
